## Activity

During April 2025, West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 445 captures. This is the reported activity total for the month and represents the volume submitted for image assessment. The activity figure provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the site during the reporting period.

## Image quality

Of the 445 captures, 32 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 7.2%. These images could not be used to produce a grading result. The ungradable total and rate should be considered when reviewing the overall quality of image capture at West Gate Eye Clinic. They also identify the proportion of activity requiring attention through the usual quality monitoring process.

## Grading

Grading identified 120 referable results. The median lag between capture and grading was 1 day. This indicates that the midpoint of the recorded grading times was 1 day for the month. The grading results, together with the image-quality figures, provide the main operational measures for April 2025.
